udt_struct_v0.doc:
One hop of a route. `venue_id` selects the adapter (liquidity source);
`token_in`/`token_out` are the swap direction at that venue; `data` is an
opaque per-venue hint (e.g. an Aquarius pool index) forwarded verbatim to
the adapter \xe2\x80\x94 empty when unused. (XDR encodes structs as name-sorted maps,
so the declared field order is cosmetic.)
udt_struct_v0.name: Leg

udt_struct_v0.doc:
An optional position-venue step around a plan. `venue_id` resolves a
[`WrapAdapter`]-shaped contract through the SAME registry as swap legs;
`token` must equal the plan's input token (pre-hook: `unwrap` funds the
plan) or output token (post-hook: `wrap` deposits `min_out` of it); `data`
is an opaque per-venue hint, empty when unused.
udt_struct_v0.name: Hook

udt_struct_v0.doc:
One parallel route in a split plan: a sequential `route` (leg-chain) that
consumes `amount_in` of the plan's input token. A plan is a `Vec<SplitRoute>`;
every route shares the same first `token_in` and last `token_out`, and their
`amount_in`s sum to the total the caller approves. A non-split swap is just a
1-element plan.
udt_struct_v0.name: SplitRoute

function_v0.doc:
Execute a swap `plan` \xe2\x80\x94 one or more parallel routes that each consume
their own `amount_in` of the shared input token and converge on the shared
output token. The Router pulls the total input once (or `unwrap`s it out
of the caller's position via `pre_hook`), threads each route's amount
through its legs, measures the combined output as its own balance delta,
requires it to be \xe2\x89\xa5 `min_out`, and delivers it to `to` \xe2\x80\x94 either directly
or, via `post_hook`, by `wrap`ping exactly `min_out` into a position for
`to` and paying the surplus to `caller` as the underlying. Reverts (atomically) if
the deadline has passed, the plan is malformed, `to` is the Router,
a venue is unregistered, any leg fails, a hook misbehaves, or the
combined output falls short. A non-split swap is a 1-element plan.
function_v0.name: swap

function_v0.doc:
Expected combined output for a `plan`. No auth, no transfers. Sums each
route's chained `quote_leg`; the API simulates this to certify the number
it returns. Each route is quoted against the *current* state, so a plan
whose routes share a pool quotes optimistically \xe2\x80\x94 execution is
sequential and later routes see earlier routes' price impact.
function_v0.name: quote

function_v0.doc: Current admin (registry owner), or `None` if ownership was renounced.
function_v0.name: get_admin

function_v0.doc: Expected position shares for wrapping `amount` through `hook` \xe2\x80\x94 proxies\nthe wrap adapter's `quote_wrap`. No auth, no transfers; the API simulates\nthis to price a post-hook (`amount = min_out`).
function_v0.name: quote_hook

function_v0.doc: Accept a pending admin transfer (proposed admin's auth required).
function_v0.name: accept_admin

function_v0.doc: Deploy-time setup (atomic with deployment \xe2\x80\x94 there is no window in which\nan unowned Router exists). `admin` owns the adapter registry.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: Begin a two-step admin transfer. `live_until_ledger = 0` cancels.
function_v0.name: propose_admin

function_v0.doc: Register (or replace) the adapter for `venue_id`. Admin-only \xe2\x80\x94 this is\nthe allowlist that bounds which contracts the Router will ever call.\n`venue_id` 0 is reserved (it means "no hook" in `RouteSwap` events).
function_v0.name: register_adapter

function_v0.doc: Remove the adapter for `venue_id`; subsequent plans naming it revert\nwith `VenueNotRegistered`. Admin-only. The explicit kill switch for a\ncompromised or retired venue.
function_v0.name: unregister_adapter

event_v0.doc: Event emitted when an ownership transfer is initiated.
event_v0.name: OwnershipTransfer

event_v0.doc: Event emitted when an ownership transfer is completed.
event_v0.name: OwnershipTransferCompleted
